notes: «كلهم عن نافع» is the shared tail; the Companion Abu Sa'id appears only in the variant remark after the full stop, so the routes end at Nafi'.
«بنحو حديث الليث عن نافع، عن أبي سعيد، الخدري» names another transmitter (Laith) for the same saying and is a variant group, not a route.
«ابن، أبي عدي» is written without the first name in the text and is not completed.
